title: Account recovery: charter
problem_statement: Members who forget their password must ask support to get back in.
in_scope: A registered member can reset a forgotten password through an emailed single-use link.
assumptions: A member's email account is under the member's control.
risks: Reset links could be replayed or guessed to take over accounts.

user_segments.description: People with an account and a verified email address.
jobs_to_be_done: Get back into my account quickly

success_metrics.name: Time To Recover
success_metrics.measurement_method: Median time from reset request to successful login, from the auth service log.
